create_co3d_dataset: create a Co3dDataset instance to load CO3D category sequences with camera poses and images
get_data_from_sequence: get data from a specific CO3D sequence by index or name with selected image IDs
jitter_bbox_augmentation: jitter a bounding box with random scale and translation for data augmentation
crop_image_with_bbox: crop a PIL image to a bounding box region with optional white background
compute_square_bbox: compute a square bounding box from an xyxy bbox with optional padding
